sloka: आश्रमम् प्रति याते तु खरे खर पराक्रमे ।तान् एव औत्पातिकान् रामः सह भ्रात्रा ददर्श ह ॥३-२४-१॥
transliteration: āśramam prati yāte tu khare khara parākrame ।tān eva autpātikān rāmaḥ saha bhrātrā dadarśa ha ॥3-24-1॥

translations.english: When Khara endowed with malicious might was marching towards the hermitage, Rama and his brother saw the same omens of impending calamity the demon had seen.
